name: The Tower of Althalaxx
objectiveText: Talk to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post.

comments.body:
The end text entered here is incorrect (it is the end text of an earlier Tower of Althalaxx quest). The correct end text is:

I knew you would be up to the task, <Name>.

I sense great deeds before you, and that you will right many wrongs that plague our lands. Bear my blessings, <Name>, as well as this gift.

<Choose your reward, complete quest>

This one was a real challenge.  Here are some tips.

1) Always take out the caster first.  They have less health and cause far more damage.  Then do the Voidwalker (caster's demonic pet).

2) You have to move quickly.  The mobs respawn rapidly.  Make certain you have a good supply of food, water, bandages, and potions.

3) If you find yourself struggling, buy or make some shadow protection potions.  The casters spell damage is shadow.  I used one in the final fight.  It probably wasn't necessary, but I wanted the insurance.

4) For a Druid or Rogue, use stealth and start with the most damaging attack possible on each caster.  You want to eliminate the caster ASAP.  The value of melee is it slows their casting rate.

5) The casters move.  When they move, chase them down as fast as possible to minimize their casting and to keep your DPS as high as possible.

6) Some of the mobs patrol.  Be aware of that so you don't take an add.  If you get two, you will probably need to run, and hope you don't get more adds.

7) For the mobs on either side of the boss you will need a distance pull.  You don't want to agro the boss, too.  Use an instant cast spell when they have moved as far from the boss as possible.  Then, run down a level and the caster and pet will follow (line of sight, pull).

8) I found the boss easy, but I used a Shadow Protection potion, and cast Regrowth and Rejuvenation prior to opening up with Starfire & Moonfire, followed by going into cat form, and going all out with DPS.

Good luck.  This one wasn't easy for my level 30 Druid.

By the way, my gear is all greens with one blue from Gnomer.  This is not a twinked toon.

I managed to solo this with a 31 level human mage, Arcane Spec'ed. Died 3 times, but only needed to die once.

I went to the tower steps, killed the lvl 17 gray annoyances, then hit mana shield and dampen magic, ran up the steps to the top and died there. Should have run to the level before the top. Died at the top twice before I figured this out.

Anyway, rez at the level below Narassin (after waiting for wandering warlock to go upstairs), quickly drink and eat conjured food. Wait for wandering warlock to come down, sheep him, then kill voidwalker, I used mana shield to protect me. After VW is dead, attack sheep. Eat and drink again.

Walk up ramp until the first set of Warlock and Void Walker are in sight. Rinse and repeat from below. Walk up the stair to where Warlock and VW were. Eat and Drink. Rinse and repeat for each set until you clear the path to Narassin. Really easy.

Narassin is a warrior class, so he was easy to beat alone. Mana Shield is wonderful. After getting the head, I put up mana sheild again, jumped down the inside of the tower (instead of running down the ramps) then used Blink once I got out of the tower and continued running until aggro was lost. Then went to Balthule and turned in the quest.

Like I said, real easy.

The last quest is available at lv 20, so I had a friend walk me thru it. The weapon level is 26 (always 5 levels lower than the item level), which is sweet for a lowbie alt. It's too bad the quest level was 20 instead of 15 like all the pre-reqs, this would be a good pvp weapon in WSG.

comments.body:
I almost didn't try this solo because of these comments that make it seem really difficult. Was bored so I gave it a shot and managed to solo it as a 27 druid, no stealth needed.

There are two patrols - maybe 3 - that you need to watch out for. All mobs in the tower include a caster + voidwalker and you can always fight just 1 group at a time if you avoid the patrols.

Clear your way up to the tower (or stealth to the 2nd level from the top). Kill anything on that level to make it safe.

From there you can pull the caster + voidwalker groups one at a time, careful to aggro only 1 group. After aggro just run down to the level below the top and fight them there. Repeat until just the level 31 boss remains and he's an easy solo kill (easier than the groups unless you're too low to hit him, which was a slight problem at 27 (4 levels below)).

For me as a druid the best strat was full health/mana, cast regrowth, moonfire the caster to aggro, then pop cat form and run down (not all the way down, just to the next level). This allows you to almost kill the voidwalker before the caster gets to you. You can LOS the caster a bit too.

Beware patrols and fast respawns...but you can clear out the patrol and the entire top level before anything respawns, as long as you aren't dying or taking forever between pulls.
